name: mirage
text: Coordinated: the other session (tj Gmail) already released v1.0.36 at 17:05, and it holds the faster bid desk (the desk's writes no longer rewrite a multi-MB file about 700 times a pass, plus a bigger per-game bid limit). The one feature not in it was the sharp-confirmed bid step-down (4% down to 1.5% under the sharp book), which sat on an unmerged branch. I merged it, fixed two tests it broke (low-usage 'quick' bids keep their own 2.5% margin) and the full suite passes (4,100+ tests). It's ready as v1.0.37, but my release step was blocked by the permission check on this session, so it is NOT released yet. Say 'release it' again, or release v1.0.37 from the Actions tab, and it ships.
